entry.original: Override the creature's usual erratic blinking, allowing a directed way to blink to a chosen location within range.

UnusedTranslations.entry: Anula el parpadeo errático habitual de la criatura, permitiendo una forma dirigida de parpadear a una ubicación elegida dentro del alcance.

entry.original: Willingly trigger a powerful self-destructive explosion, sacrificing this animal in a final act that unleashes all stored volatile compounds in a devastating blast.

entry.original: Shroud the animal in a veil of controlled invisibility, vanishing from sight while retaining full awareness and precision.

UnusedTranslations.entry: Envuelve al animal en un velo de invisibilidad controlada, desapareciendo de la vista mientras mantiene total conciencia y precisión.
